answer.reason: The verses tell two things this Rab-mag did, sitting in the middle gate of the captured city and helping to take Jeremiah from the prison.

clauses.english: sat with the princes of Babylon in the middle gate of captured Jerusalem
clauses.quote: came in, and sat in the middle gate

clauses.english: helped send for Jeremiah and took him out of the court of the prison
clauses.quote: took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison

doubts: JER 39:3 names Nergalsharezer twice; only the one called Rabmag is taken as this record, and the first, the summary's companion, is left out.
